questions.why: Lipase is secreted by the pancreas and acts in the small intestine; bile is not an enzyme.

questions.q: Which is a function of bile?
options: digests fats into fatty acids and glycerol
emulsifies fats to increase the surface area for lipase
gives an acidic pH for proteases
questions.why: Bile emulsifies fats (physical, not chemical) and neutralises acid entering the duodenum.

questions.q: A lack of which nutrient causes rickets?
questions.why: Rickets is caused by a lack of vitamin D; a lack of vitamin C causes scurvy.

questions.model: The breakdown of large insoluble molecules into small soluble molecules.
points: broken down into small soluble molecules
